title: Account Executive
tagline: Client-team switchboard. You take every call.
intro: 8 AM: three missed client calls. You ride from Wuxing St. to A25 answering LINE at red lights, planning which drafts to chase from creative, media, and data. When the client says “Show us something first,” you're the one who catches it.

perk.name: Client Whisperer
perk.desc: One extra chance to calm the client. Client Trust bonus on options about client talks and owning problems.

title: Strategic Planner
tagline: Finds what the brand should say, from insight
intro: Your desk always has three reports and a pad of sticky notes spread out. When others ask “What do we do?” you ask “Why?” The night before a pitch, you rewrite the first line of the deck until version twelve.

perk.name: Insight Sticky Notes
perk.desc: Before each choice, see an insight hint from that year's book.

title: Media Planner
tagline: Decides where the budget goes and when it shows
intro: Your Excel holds TV, MRT, YouTube, LINE, and 100-plus ad slots. Where the client's money goes, which day it runs, how many times: it all gets worked out to two decimal places. Media rate cards are your breakfast side dish.

perk.name: Slot Math
perk.desc: Sales bonus on options about budget, ad slots, and media mix.

title: Creative
tagline: Turns strategy into something people want to see
intro: Your day starts with screening footage and ends with revisions, with two pitches and one bento fight with the director in between. When the client says “Make it a bit younger,” only you know what that means.

perk.name: Good Story
perk.desc: Brand Power bonus on options about content, story, and visuals.

title: Data Analyst
tagline: Proves or busts everyone's gut feeling with data
intro: Everyone thinks you do magic, but 80% of your time goes to cleaning data. When someone in a meeting says “I think,” you quietly open the report. Your most-used line: “Where did this number come from?”

perk.name: Process of Elimination
perk.desc: In quizzes, you can rule out one wrong answer first.

title: CX & E-com Consultant
intro: You watch where customers come in, where they get stuck, and why they don't check out. Lay member data, carts, and service logs side by side, and you see the problem. Client says “Conversion's low”? You ask: “Where do customers hesitate?”

perk.name: Journey Map
perk.desc: Client Trust bonus on options about members, customer experience, and customer service.
